articles.mainIdea: Is American Airlines (AAL) Using Free Wi‑Fi and Its Centennial to Redefine Brand Moat?
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Is American Airlines (AAL) Using Free Wi‑Fi and Its Centennial to Redefine Brand Moat?. In recent days, American Airlines has restored much of its disrupted Caribbean schedule, begun rolling out free high-speed Wi‑Fi with AT&T across its fleet, and kicked off year‑long centennial celebrations with special branding and customer offerings. Together, these moves highlight how American is using operational recovery, upgraded connectivity, and its 100‑year milestone to reinforce its brand and passenger experience.
